meta.name: alert-management
meta.description: Inspect fired CCAM alerts and manage alert rules for token thresholds, event patterns, inactivity, and status duration. Use when acknowledging alerts, creating or editing a rule, checking cooldowns, or connecting alert rules to webhook targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接收并确认告警，按需求调整触发规则，把提醒送进指定通知渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果工作中常常需要处理告警，想自己调整规则和通知方式。
copy.tagline_en: Acknowledge alerts, tune rules, send reminders to your channel.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle alerts at work and want to adjust rules and notifications yourself.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查看已触发的警报和现有警报规则，还能按你的要求创建、修改或删除规则，以及确认警报。改动前会先展示规则详情并征求意见。
howto.when: 当你要求确认警报、创建或修改规则、查看冷却时间等时触发。

say.text: 查看当前未确认的警报。
帮我新建一个令牌阈值规则，总量100万token，冷却300秒。
say.note: 会先显示规则配置，确认后创建。

say.text: 把规则ID为12的规则改为不活动模式。
say.note: 会先展示该规则当前配置，确认后更新。

howto.what_en: Claude can inspect fired alerts and list existing alert rules, and create, update, or delete rules on request. It shows rule details and asks for confirmation before any change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to acknowledge alerts, create/edit rules, check cooldowns, or link rules to webhooks.

say_en.text: Create a token threshold rule for 1M tokens with 300s cooldown.
